system.description:
Your "Symbol of the Sun" "Sanctuary" becomes "Target: Wide Area 2 (Select)", and the effect of "Sanctuary" will now last until the target is more than 3 Sq away from you instead of just until they leave your Sq. The Axe of Saint Lirys, a character from the story of the People of the Land. She was once a poor woodcutter's daughter, but after her father was killed by a tyrant, she took up an axe, inspired the people, and led a rebellion to avenge her father. The story ends there, and her fate is unknown, but the axe that guided and protected the people is now in your hands.

Great Jade Fang [Core Material] (620G) + Heavy Flail (1400G) + [Magic Catalyst 19] (340G) ×3 + Crafting Cost (1080G)
